newsitem.title: USA: NeoPharm in Canadian development pact.
newsitem.headline: NeoPharm in Canadian development pact.

text.p: NeoPharm Inc, a development stage drug company, said Wednesday it has signed a collaboration agreement for a BioChem Pharma unit to develop, market and distribute broxuridine in Canada.
Terms of the transaction with BioChem Therapeutic Inc were not disclosed, although BioChem will make an initial up-front payment and milestone-based payments, NeoPharm said.
Once broxuridine is marketed in Canada, the two companies will share product revenue. NeoPharm will supply commercial quantities of broxuridine for sale in Canada.

Broxuridine is under development at NeoPharm for a number of potential applications, including as a radiation sensitizer for its potential to enhance the effectiveness of radiation therapy in tumor types such as malignant gliomas and cervical cancer, NeoPharm said.

Broxuridine is also under development for its use as an in vivo prognostic test to measure tumor cell proliferation in breast cancer. Broxuridine may have a number of other potential indications both as a radiation sensitizer and a prognostic marker, the company said.
NeoPharm shares were unchanged at five Wednesday.
